# #227 MAYOS-authored staple exercises
## Parent
#224
## What to build
Staples the ExerciseDB rows lack are added as MAYOS-authored exercises (ADR 053): Kelso shrug, Bayesian curl, cable Y-raise and machine hip thrust. They live in their own id namespace, carry MAYOS provenance, have owner-reviewed instructions written in MAYOS's own words, and ship with no media.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The four exercises exist in the Exercise library with target and secondary muscles, body part, equipment and instructions, in an id namespace that cannot collide with ExerciseDB ids, marked with MAYOS provenance - [ ] Instructions are MAYOS's own wording (ADR 011: no reference-author phrasing) and are reviewed by the owner in the PR - [ ] Each has a display name and aliases; name search and similarity search find them (search embeddings computed on load) - [ ] Exercise detail and the logger show them cleanly with no media - [ ] Adding a further authored exercise is only a new row in the same seed source plus review
